name: PhoneFrame
summary: Decorative chrome that mocks a phone shell for marketing / showcase / docs. Renders the device silhouette (notch, Dynamic Island, home indicator, status bar slot) and clips its child to the screen bounds. Three platforms — ios-notch, ios-island (Dynamic Island), android-pin-hole. Distinct from the iOS / Android platform docs — PhoneFrame is presentation, not runtime.

statusBar.description: Slot for the StatusBar primitive. When omitted, a neutral status bar is rendered.

showHomeIndicator.description: ios-* only. Render the bottom 5 px-tall home indicator pill.

background.description: Optional background fill behind the child content. Defaults to color.surface.page.

rules: PhoneFrame is presentational. role='img' + aria-label='Phone mockup, {platform}' so SR users know it's a frame, not a real device.
Children inside should still be readable to SR — don't aria-hide the children with the frame.

do: Use PhoneFrame in marketing hero shots and onboarding gifs.
Pair with StatusBar to make the chrome look real.
Center-anchor the home indicator within the safe-area-inset-bottom band.
For the showcase, alias size to the same px the audit-dashboard mobile breakpoint uses.
dont: Don't use PhoneFrame in the operator dashboard chrome — it's marketing/docs presentation only.
Don't render real device skins (Apple / Pixel) with brand marks — that's a TM issue. The Lumen frame is a stylized silhouette.
Don't sit a real interactive flow inside PhoneFrame in production code. Build the flow at the real viewport size.

changelog.note: Initial PhoneFrame contract. Three platform silhouettes. Three sizes. Two rotations.
